conditions_held: same inherited host/model setting; exact underlying model revision not independently pinned

objective_checks: page overflow and reachability at 390 and 1440
keyboard controls and visible focus where relevant

content/function under doubled text where applicable; extra observations recorded separately from required-task pass/fail

subjective_rubric.task_clarity: 1: primary task unclear; 3: findable with competing emphasis; 5: immediate, coherent task path
subjective_rubric.composition: 1: collision or flat undifferentiated hierarchy; 3: orderly but formulaic; 5: deliberate focal point and balanced supporting rhythm
subjective_rubric.identity: 1: interchangeable stock treatment; 3: a coherent but familiar treatment; 5: subject-specific decisions shape composition and visual language
subjective_rubric.type_and_color: 1: visibly harmful or incoherent; 3: readable/coherent; 5: purposeful typographic relationships and controlled role palette
subjective_rubric.responsive_craft: 1: important content/actions lost; 3: usable stack with rough transitions; 5: priorities deliberately recomposed across widths

review_plan: Two fresh-context AI reviewers receive neutral labels randomized independently per case, with candidate presentation order reversed between reviewers. They get briefs, screenshots and runnable paired artifacts only; no skill versions, change rationale, run order, functional-check results or self-reports. Record anchored scores, evidence, preference/tie and limits. Maintainer checks operate real actions separately. Scores are diagnostic judgments, not a validated beauty metric.
limits: three single-run pairs; no population inference
reviewer is an AI agent, not a human user panel
revision development sees current outputs; holdout brief required to check transfer
tool tests and visual preferences remain separate
holdout: holdout: bicycle configurator; brief fixed before current output review, not used to choose revisions. Both versions evaluated after revision is frozen.
